subject: Life Skills
title: The Cooldown Protocol
description: A fast breakdown of The Cooldown Protocol for builders.

hook.text: Couples who take structured breaks during heated arguments resolve issues 60% faster than those who push through.

buildup.text: Pushing through emotional flooding leads to escalation. Your brain is literally unable to reason under flood.

discovery.text: A cooldown protocol is a pre-agreed plan: either person can call a break, and both honor it without resentment.

twist.text: Walking away without an agreed protocol feels like stonewalling. The agreement transforms retreat into strategy.

climax.text: Agree on a signal, a time limit of 20 to 30 minutes, and a promise to return. Discuss it before you need it.

punchline.text: Plan the pause before the storm. Return and resolve.

quiz.question: Why must a cooldown break be pre-agreed upon?
options: It must be timed with a stopwatch for accuracy
Without agreement, walking away feels like stonewalling
Only one person should be allowed to call breaks
